services.name: Group Tours
services.desc: Visit Heritage for memorable experiences and a wide variety of learning opportunities on a school field trip. A day of interdisciplinary fun is in store as your group engages with science, history, art, and more as they explore our exhibits, outdoor spaces, and garden features. Experience Heritage your way - either on your own, or with a guide who will lead your group for 90 minutes to help you maximize your time and fun! The Adventure Park at Heritage is also currently booking school group opportunities for 2026. To book a climb please click here.
